categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in animal husbandry focusing on cattle breeding and beef cattle farming, accounting for about 80% of its business. It also engages in frozen semen and embryo production and sales, live cattle breeding and sales, fresh beef processing and sales, land leasing, and dairy product sales. The company has expanded into downstream sectors including live cattle circulation, slaughtering, and meat product sales, aiming for full industry chain integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced breeding technologies including frozen semen production using fine-tube frozen semen technology, embryo transplantation, and progeny testing for genetic evaluation. It employs TMR (Total Mixed Ration) feeding technology for fattening cattle to improve feed conversion and meat quality. The breeding process involves purchasing and selective breeding of bulls from national core breeding farms, embryo transplantation, and targeted breeding to adapt to local environments. The company also has a comprehensive technical service system covering breeding planning, disease prevention, and feeding management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized ranches, breeding cooperatives, individual farmers, slaughterhouses, supply chain companies, restaurant chains, and online fresh food platforms. The company serves the domestic Chinese market exclusively, with a focus on regions with strong cattle farming traditions. Its meat products are sold through supply chains, catering companies, and O2O platforms such as community group buying and fresh supermarkets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with key operations in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia, two major cattle breeding regions. It has expanded downstream operations into Guangdong and the Greater Bay Area to develop slaughtering, processing, and fresh beef sales. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in Ningxia, Jilin, and other provinces, covering a broad domestic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the cattle industry supply chain, including upstream genetic breeding and frozen semen production, midstream cattle breeding and fattening, and downstream live cattle circulation, slaughtering, meat processing, and sales. It aims to build a closed-loop industry chain to mitigate risks associated with market fluctuations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on strengthening its core breeding capabilities, improving genetic quality through progeny testing and genetic evaluation, and expanding downstream meat processing and sales. R&D efforts target improving frozen semen quality, breeding efficiency, and adapting breeds to local environments. The company also emphasizes training breeding technicians and developing digital breeding data platforms to enhance service and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales including frozen semen, embryos, live cattle (breeding and fattening cattle), fresh beef products, and land leasing. Sales channels include government procurement, direct sales to ranches and cooperatives, and retail through supply chains and online platforms. The company also earns income from technical services related to breeding and cattle management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest cattle breed improvement providers in China and the only listed company specializing in cattle breed improvement in Xinjiang. It holds a leading position nationally in genetic resources, especially in breeds like Holstein, Brown Swiss, Simmental, Angus, and Limousin. It ranks second nationally in the number of top Simmental bulls. The company faces competition from other domestic breeding and cattle farming enterprises but leverages its unique genetic resources and integrated supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 137.6 million, a slight increase of 0.07% from the previous year. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 65.95 million, with losses deepening due to market downturns and asset impairments. Total assets decreased by 21.26% to RMB 248.2 million, and shareholders' equity turned negative. The company is undergoing financial challenges but is actively restructuring and expanding downstream operations to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique genetic resources and advanced breeding technologies as core competitive advantages, offering high-quality frozen semen and embryos from superior cattle breeds. It provides comprehensive technical services to improve breeding efficiency and cattle quality for customers. Its integrated industry chain from breeding to fresh beef sales ensures product quality and supply stability, aiming to build a trusted domestic high-quality beef brand.
